metric: Calcite optimizer-test pairs from the QED prover, converted from its relational-algebra JSON to SQL, proved equivalent; 1 more is shown different by a counterexample, 133 unknown.
caveats: 375 of QED's 444 cases convert to SQL; 69 use features the conversion cannot reproduce exactly and are not scored (listed with reasons in tests/fixtures/qed/qed_calcite_skipped.jsonl). Overlaps the SQLSolver and R-Bot Calcite sets (not yet deduplicated). Key-based rules were developed with these pairs in view (tuned on test).
correctness: 0 false proofs; every proof and the 1 counterexample re-run on 30 random DuckDB databases
